user_intent: Save actual intermediate-step computation using an accurate predicted endpoint plus cheap precise partial guidance and a smaller interior-state predictor.
pipeline: Encode current complete state, geometry, material properties and known control schedule once.
Predict the endpoint directly at K*output_dt; do not compute all Kfull states to obtain it.
Prepare only explicitly declared inexpensive guide signals at each requested physical time.
Decode all K-1interior complete states using shared features, current state, predicted endpoint, local elapsed time and available guides.
Use predicted endpoint and required learned history to continue the next block.

guide_candidates.name: prescribed_controls
fields: force position and amplitude over time
known source/boundary motion and fixed geometry
guide_candidates.precision: Exact relative to the declared externally prescribed schedule and its arithmetic; state-dependent feedback is not known in advance.
guide_candidates.possible_benefit: Supply temporally resolved known forcing to endpoint and interior heads without predicting it.

guide_candidates.name: local_forcing_or_viscosity_update
guide_candidates.precision: Conditional on the supplied velocity/state. Forcing can be prescribed; viscosity needs the evolving state, so a precise local calculation on a predicted state is not an exact reference field.

guide_candidates.name: tracer_transport
guide_candidates.precision: Exact reference transport requires the reference velocity history. Transport under an endpoint-interpolated or predicted velocity path is an approximate guide and must be scored.

guide_candidates.name: divergence_or_pressure_RHS
guide_candidates.precision: Derived accurately only for the supplied velocity. These are not independent precise future observations when the velocity is predicted.

precision_contract: Record every guide as prescribed-known, current-state-derived, or predicted-state-dependent.
Future reference states or RHS may create training targets or offline oracle bounds; they cannot enter the deployed generator.
A guide advertised as precise must include the cost and accuracy of every state it depends on.
A numerical-field-guide variant must identify those runtime numerical operations explicitly, alongside the learned components.
No full native pressure solve or full reference trajectory may be hidden inside the guide path.

ablation_order.purpose: Measure work and overhead without claiming temporal compute sharing.

ablation_order.candidate: Shared encoder plus direct endpoint and small interior decoder, without new guides
ablation_order.purpose: Test whether actual temporal compute can be removed.
Measure the value and cost of cheaply available temporal anchors.
Admit only after measuring its complete dependency cost and guide error; compare at equal full-state accuracy.

training: Use the240reference master trajectories to train explicit longer start-to-endpoint transitions at K/60seconds for K1,2,3,4, with interior targets j/60. Treat30/120cadence variation as a separate secondary factor.
Train interior heads with model-predicted endpoints and deployment-available guides; disclose any true-endpoint teacher-forcing mixture.
If true endpoints or reference intermediate fields are used for an offline upper bound, label it oracle-only and exclude it from deployment results.
Retain coupled equation, pressure, velocity and tracer validation so a cheap guide does not optimize one field at another field's expense.
measurement: Profile the existing GPU path first; do not select a field as cheapest from intuition or operation count alone.
Count encoder, direct endpoint prediction, guide computation and dependencies, interior decoding, all Kstate reconstructions, transfers and synchronization.
Report full block latency and divide only by Kphysical outputs for per-step latency.
Keep setup separate and retain medians, tails and observed maxima; mark every learned inference resultGPU.
Evaluate every output, causal forcing behavior and predicted-endpoint continuation; separate step size, lead time, K, density, domain shape and forcing family.
success: Reduce measured actual computation and totalGPU latency at matched complete-state accuracy, rather than just batching sequential full updates.

independent_parameters: output_dt_s: physical time between consecutive requested output states
K: number of requested consecutive physical outputs per pass
block_duration_s=K*output_dt_s: total physical time advanced by one pass
primary_temporal_contract.sampling_rule: For each start n, target output j is fine reference state n+j*4 at60outputs/s; K4endpoint is n+16, not n+4.
primary_temporal_contract.training_pairs: Train direct start-to-endpoint pairs at1/60,2/60,3/60,4/60seconds and supervise every interior state for each requestedK. Longer endpoint durations are actual training targets, not assumed generalization from shorter-dt pairs.
primary_temporal_contract.endpoint_prediction: Predict endpoint directly or in a shared latent computation that removes expensive intermediate full-state updates; do not obtain it by secretly running Kfull one-step predictions.
primary_temporal_contract.interior_generation: Smaller decoder receives the starting state, model-predicted endpoint, shared features and deployment-available guides, and returns intermediate states at j*output_dt.
primary_temporal_contract.continuation: Advance the next block start by K*output_dt using the predicted endpoint and complete required history.
primary_temporal_contract.compute_accounting: Record expensive learned/module evaluations, any remaining sequential stages, guide work, all Kdecoded states and full transfers. A single wrapped call containing Kfull updates remains the sequential baseline.
timing_metrics: full block wall time inms onGPU
block wall time divided byKphysical outputs
simulated seconds advanced per wall second:1000*K*output_dt_s/block_ms
totalGPU wall time to generate the same10seconds at60outputs/s with600outputs, including successive predicted-state continuation
primary_temporal_contract.accuracy: Score allKpressure/velocity/tracer states and reference-equation errors, plus own-state continuation across equal physical duration.
primary_temporal_contract.output_rate_generalization: 30and120output steps/s remain secondary cadence settings. For each setting block duration is still K/output_rate. They do not substitute for longer-horizon training at fixed60outputs/s.
not_multistep: Dividing1/60second into4outputs does not advance4frames at60outputs/s.
A K4block at120outputs/s advances4/120second; it is a different physical interval from K4at60outputs/s.
Using30outputs/s changes output sampling; it is not evidence of faster generation at the required60outputsteps/s.
